note: BH-7695. Space-separated env names a project's suite needs (A-Z, 0-9, _ only). The suite preflight treats each empty one as a SOFT item: the suite still runs, a green stays green, and a red becomes HARNESS_EXIT: could-not-run: <name> (suite rc <n>) in the build and host suite: could-not-run: <name> (suite rc <n>) in the lead review. Empty = only node_modules and DATABASE_URL (prisma repos, on a DB-error signature) are checked. Per project: lane.fly-pool.<project>.suite_preflight_env.
